denominator: hectare used by the represented system: full crop rotation, grazing range, or terrestrial foraging range; never multiplied by cell area
energy_requirement_status: shared reporting assumption, not a medieval observed diet or adult-only demographic requirement

forge.license: publisher supplementary download; redistribution rights not established
forge.density_interpretation: published model output under modern climate; not observed population. Energy proxy uses product of annual mean density and intake, not exact time-integrated flux. S0-S2 span is environmental/model sensitivity, not historical technology endpoints

pastoral.status: experimental transfer: wild grazer standing biomass per grass hectare is a stocking proxy, NOT a validated domestic stocking rate. Product coefficients are later tropical African cattle/mixed/small-ruminant analogues; transferred to other pastoral regions with low confidence. No livestock calories are added to crop calories.
pastoral.retention_status: 15 percent loss assumption; not part of the observed pastoral product coefficients

classification_status: complete conditional food-system mask; historical presence and dominance inferred, not measured for every cell
forage_resampling: local climate-conditioned interpolation; source means use matched 2-degree climate aggregation; no rectangular nearest fill. Fine spatial detail inferred, not independently observed.
hyde_role: not used to assign food types or calculate per-hectare values: HYDE land extent does not identify staple crops and its population dependence is inappropriate here
polar_zero_rule: GAEZ land south of 60 S: Antarctic terrestrial-zero convention; marine food excluded. Reconciles gaps in the ecological ice geometry.

climate_transfer.license: WorldClim attribution required; exact version-2.1 redistribution terms not verified; raw files not redistributed
climate_transfer.status: environmental interpolation experiment; modern climate covariates do not establish medieval micro-scale productivity
